direct_growth_rationale: Group growth is constructed as a judgment across cigarettes, other FMCG, agri, paper and other businesses. FY26 revenue is net of excise to avoid interpreting higher tax pass-through as economic growth. Cigarette taxation and illicit-trade substitution constrain the downside. Group EBITDA margin is a mix approximation and SOTP values each segment separately.

drivers.source: FY26 consolidated statements and latest result presentation

research_notes.finding: FY26 gross operating revenue INR89913.33cr includes excise INR11044.93cr. Model revenue is net INR78868.40cr. Operating EBITDA remains INR27317.91cr because excise is removed from both revenue and expenses. A gross revenue surge does not establish volume growth.

FY25 total consolidated PAT INR35052.48cr includes discontinued operations and a large demerger effect. It is not the recurring earnings baseline. Retained equity-method hotel exposure is included only in nonoperating investments, not a hotel operating segment.

Cigarettes, branded foods, agri and paper have different economics. SOTP applies explicit scenario-specific EBIT multiples to each disclosed segment and capitalises corporate costs separately. Multiples are analyst judgments pending sector-matched peer evidence.

FY26 net borrowing changed sharply and employee share issues occurred. FCFE is excluded as a primary method. No new equity issuance is assumed in the forecast. Current fully diluted option allocation remains a limitation.
Long regular distributions support a secondary DDM. Its payout assumptions and terminal ROE are explicit judgments and not independent confirmation of DCF.

market_notes: 31-Mar-2026 balance and share basis rolled forward with estimated uniform interim FCFE, not a reported October balance.
Assume INR8.25 per share distribution after balance date. Payment timing is an explicit analyst case assumption, not independently confirmed bank settlement.
16-Oct close is the last dated reference used here. Latest intraday prices and later dilution are not asserted.
Other debt-like claims and nonoperating assets are carrying-value proxies. Minority buyout, pension and lease policies are described in Research.
issues: Conditional analyst scenarios, not a precise fair-value recommendation. Capital costs, terminal returns, current cash bridge and multiples require analyst review.
